notes: REF-BM-02: only title is auto-collected via /api/title + <title> scrape; no description, favicon, or preview image fields/logic exist anywhere. REF-BM-03: title is editable before save (titleTouched guard in app.js), but no description field exists and no post-save edit UI exists at all. REF-BM-04: no edit function/UI for any bookmark field after creation. REF-BM-05: no delete function/UI anywhere in app.js/core.js. REF-BM-06: duplicate save is detected (BM.ADD_DUPLICATE) and the UI banner links/scrolls to the existing item, but since no edit feature exists at all, it cannot actually 'guide to edit' — it only prevents the duplicate and highlights the existing row. REF-BM-07: list item shows title, url, and tags only; no description or favicon rendered (core.js/app.js have no such fields). REF-BM-12: search (BookmarkStore.search/render filter) only matches displayName (title) and url; there is no note or description field in the data model to search. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' search syntax; tags are only browsed via clickable tagbar chips (renderTagbar), not parsed from the search string. REF-BM-15: search is a single plain case-insensitive substring match (core.js BookmarkStore.search); no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses parsing exists. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase parsing; search string is used verbatim as one substring. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag anywhere in the Bookmark object or UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/logic. REF-BM-22: list is always sorted newest-first (BookmarkStore.all sorts by savedAt desc) with no user-selectable sort key (title, etc.) and no UI control for it. REF-BM-23: no note/markdown field exists on the bookmark model. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/archival-fetch or Internet Archive integration in server.js or core.js. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive list/view. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or save-search-as-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export code. REF-BM-32: no settings/preferences UI or storage (displayed items, font size, default sort) exists.
